name: João Pinho Monteiro
focus: Noncoding variants, lncRNAs and transcriptional architecture of vascular cells
bio: João earned his PhD at the University of Edinburgh studying endothelial non-coding RNA in vascular remodelling, and continued there as a British Heart Foundation–funded postdoc. He joined the lab in 2022 as a postdoctoral fellow and is now an Instructor in Cardiovascular Medicine, studying how noncoding risk variants interact with activator and repressor proteins to shape transcription in vascular cells.
